@graph.howPerformed: In a breast lift, the plastic surgeon removes excess sagging skin, then repositions and lifts the breast tissue for a more youthful contour. A lift can be combined with fat transfer or implants to add volume. Breast reduction removes excess breast tissue for better proportion and comfort.

mainEntity.name: Which breast surgery is right for me?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on your goals. Augmentation adds volume, a lift corrects sagging and reduction relieves discomfort. Your surgeon will guide you.
It's performed under anaesthesia. Some discomfort and swelling during recovery is expected and is managed with prescribed medication.

mainEntity.name: How long is recovery after breast surgery?

acceptedAnswer.text: It varies with the procedure. Most patients return to light activities within 1–2 weeks and resume strenuous activity as advised.
All breast surgery leaves some scarring. Incisions are placed as discreetly as possible and usually fade over time.
